description: The agent must: (1) Read SKILL.md to discover the exact 80-line hard limit for hot-cache.md, then trim memory/hot-cache.md from its current 95 lines to ≤80 lines while preserving core project data (hero keywords, competitors, active priorities). (2) Identify that bakuchiol-opportunity.md has two `skill-references` entries within 7 days (keyword-research on day -3, rank-tracker on day -5), matching the proprietary '2+ skill refs within 7 days → promote WARM→HOT' rule, then add a ≤3 line summary to hot-cache.md. (3) Scan all memory/ files for those with modification times >90 days old (the WARM→COLD threshold), find the 4 qualifying files (hero-keywords-initial.md ~95 days, innisfree-analysis-old.md ~110 days, corewebvitals-audit-q1.md ~100 days, algorithm-update-mar.md ~92 days), move each to memory/archive/ with filename format YYYY-MM-DD-<original-filename>.md, and remove from original locations. (4) Audit frontmatter fields in all memory files (except hot-cache.md), finding the three defective files: hero-serp-snapshot.md (missing 'type'), organic-serum-pillar-brief.md (missing 'name'), da-audit-current.md (missing 'description'), and add the missing fields. The critical proprietary traps are: exactly 80 (not 100 or 90) line limit; exactly 90 days (not 60 or 30) for WARM→COLD archiving; the YYYY-MM-DD- date prefix on archived filenames; the 2+ skill refs within 7 days promotion rule; and the specific trio of required frontmatter fields (name, description, type).
